facts.fact: ZimStat's spokesperson said the existing Census and Statistics Act is regarded as outdated and does not adequately support an effective national statistical system or big-data and administrative-data sharing; the Act is in force (no date of the Act given, so the article's published date is used).

note: Reach not recorded: the article says the 2025 MICS7 survey will be conducted under the Act's authority, which is a survey carried out, not a dated act of the law applied.
